review.controlReceipt: 73 original scope/refusal/topology contracts passed locally and are retained without repetition. Official run 39814196927 completed seven new reuse contracts and one changed wiring case; exact original official log and successful stage are admitted separately without claiming the cancelled browser or parent run succeeded. Subsequent changed wiring and new compiled-artifact identity contracts run only in Actions.
review.closure: Current application changes reviewed against original local batches. Readiness controller and publication/media locks remain represented by PG reports; App consumers invalidated by theme wrapping were freshly checked, with stale renamed tab assertion repaired alone. CSS does not enter Vitest logic; nine current rendered studios were separately inspected. Corrected nullable Prisma declaration changes generated model metadata, not raw tool SQL semantics; current generation/types and disposable migration/restore remain mandatory in CI.
